details: VELDO-0078 detail: install/assets: .veldo/control_backlog.py installed by the scaffold; .veldo/control_backlog.py engine copy identical; .veldo/control_backlog.py laid by the installer

VELDO-0078 detail: priority/declared-set: the four kinds of work stand where they were driven, the prioritized one now active; only prioritized work is offered or claimed, at every entry; the prioritized item was prioritized by its owner before its first claim

VELDO-0078 detail: priority/missing-priority: the admitted item has its owner's admission and no priority; its units are admitted by record and still PLANNED; the Gate's selection accepts it, and the frontier still does not offer it; the direct task claim is refused for missing priority, and the ledger was never asked; the task claim through the authority is refused for missing priority; the claim receiver refuses it; the backlog names the reason for both units
VELDO-0078 detail: priority/store-inspection: the store holds executable units; the only claims are of prioritized units; intake-only work has no unit and prepared work no admission

VELDO-0078 detail: priority/owner-decision: an admission answer does not prioritize; another project_owner member's settled answer does not prioritize; an answer to another brief does not prioritize; prepared work is not prioritized; an applied admission is not applied again; the admitted item is unchanged

VELDO-0078 detail: lifecycle/foreign-sources: a feature is taken into the backlog once; policy-admitted work classes are not taken in this release; only a feature is taken; the intake-only item carries no admission and no priority

VELDO-0078 detail: activation/first-claim: the owner prioritized the approved decomposition; the first claim is granted and activates the item; the claim, the unit and the item agree on the owner; the other approved unit is ready and unclaimed; a second holder is refused

VELDO-0078 detail: activation/decomposition-growth: each append is a new decomposition revision of the active item; an appended unit is PLANNED, not executable; the claim receiver refuses the appended unit; the task claim refuses the appended unit for missing priority; an approved unit continues meanwhile; the earlier prioritization does not cover the appended units; an answer to an earlier revision is refused; the fresh prioritization of the current revision makes them executable; then they are claimed

VELDO-0078 detail: blocked/resume-binding: the block records the interrupted phase and its reason; every open unit is blocked at the Gate and at the claim; no settled answer does not resume; an answer about another subject does not resume; an answer bound to another block does not resume; the owner's refusal keeps it blocked; the owner's settled resolution resumes exactly that phase; its blockers are cleared and the work continues

VELDO-0078 detail: done/missing-outcome: the declared outputs exist and are reported; a path-only output is not DONE; the task with its product on disk is not concluded without an accepted outcome; a canceled attempt is not an outcome; a missing required receipt is not DONE; an incomplete landing receipt or one for another revision is not DONE; the one completion reader agrees; the item is still ACTIVE

VELDO-0078 detail: done/authorized-alternative: a disposal without a settled answer is refused; another member's settled answer does not authorize it; an outcome this release does not name is refused; the owner's settled answer authorizes the alternative outcome

VELDO-0078 detail: done/accepted-outcomes: complete receipts and the authorized alternative make it DONE; each unit's outcome is recorded by its receipt or its authorization; the task is concluded from its accepted outcome; DONE is terminal

VELDO-0078 detail: lifecycle/regular-path: the main item walked the regular path to DONE; a rejected item is REJECTED with its units canceled; a returned item goes back to PREPARED and is groomed again; only the project's owner cancels; the owner's cancel is terminal and cancels its units
VELDO-0078 detail: other-process: the other process read the store read-only; it sees the DONE item and the admitted one; it gets the same executable answers; it gets the same outcome answers
VELDO-0078 detail: observability: accepted and refused commands are counted; the pending work is exposed
